description: This university group project challenged us to develop an experimental game exploring the concept '(dis)entanglement.'

As the sole designer and project manager, I had to ensure everyone is on the same page. Starting with an analog prototype everyone understood the concept: Players navigate through interconnected Möbius strips to earn further strips; expanding the entanglement until it's too complicated to find paths.

To further balance my dual role, I merged task distribution with GDD creation: Based on an in-engine gameplay mockup timeline I created & distributed action documents, which also served as GDD foundation.
Lastly, since we lacked a dedicated sound designer I reduced the scope to composing atmospheric sounds myself.
